title: Landnam world
description: A world is the set of game objects (terrain, clouds, weather, sky events) that web and native step with the same physics. Compiled to shared/scenes/<name>.json, which both platforms load unchanged.

format.description: Authoring format version. Not copied into the compiled JSON.

version.description: Runtime schema version read by web and native.

about.description: Plain-language description of the world and its units.

sprites.description: Named sprite frames. Each carries its Blender frame: w, h, x0 (left edge from the entity x) and v0 (bottom edge from the entity y).

prefabs.description: Entity templates spawned by emitters and the sky calendar (rain, meteors, exhaust).

biomes.description: Each landscape's own horizon, far ground, plants and drifts, added to the shared entities.

gravity.description: Acceleration along y, kit units per second squared. Negative falls.

fixedStep.description: Simulation step in seconds. Web and native must match.

groundY.description: Height of the ground line in kit units.

x0.description: Left edge relative to the entity x.

v0.description: Bottom edge relative to the entity y.

body.description: Simple physics for a moving entity.

vx.description: Horizontal velocity, kit units per second.

vy.description: Vertical velocity, kit units per second.

wind.description: How strongly the body follows the wind, 0 to 1.

ground.description: What happens when the body reaches the ground.

bounce.description: Rebound strength when ground is bounce.

life.description: Seconds until the body is removed.

pitch.description: Heading change per second for thrusting bodies, radians.

id.description: Stable name. Spawned prefabs have none.

shape.description: Drawn shape when there is no sprite.

x.description: Position along the strip, kit units.

y.description: Height above the ground line, kit units.

depth.description: Parallax factor. 1 moves with the strip, 0 stays with the screen.

layer.description: Draw order. Higher draws in front.

sky.description: Sky objects live in screen space instead of on the strip.

wrap.description: [min, max] x range the entity wraps around.

emit.description: Spawns a prefab on a timer.
